rule: Dev, test, training and showcase seeds are disjoint: no seed appears in more than one clip, so no seed has two roles. Checked by python -m vision.footage check (and pytest). Each clip is `minutes` of a full 90-minute match from `start_minute` (default 0, the kickoff). Dev seeds were picked for having a shot in their first 2 minutes. test1's seed was fixed without looking at its events. test2's rule was fixed before any rendering or grading (#35): the first seed after test1's (2101), unused in any role, whose minutes 40-50 hold at least 1 goal, same pairing as test1; found by running the simulator only, no vision code or grader (python -m vision.footage find-seed --after 2101 --home bosphorus --away thames --start-minute 40 --minutes 10 --goals 1). The showcase clip (#82) is chosen for its content, not held out, and is never a grade to report as accuracy: of seeds 2301-2500 (unused in any role), pairing Bosphorus v Thames, the 10-minute window starting on a whole minute and ending by minute 58 ranked best by action (a red card, 2+ goals, a yellow card, a second-yellow red, then goals + cards, then the margin of the first and last of them from the window edges; ties to the lower seed and earlier start); natural engine rates, no preset; found with the simulator only (python -m vision.footage find-showcase --first 2301 --last 2500). Training uses 6 clips (18,000 frames, about 22 players each) covering six further pairings; add clips if detector recall needs more.

clips.name: test1
clips.note: held out: never used for dev or training

clips.name: test2
clips.note: held out: goals, half-time and the second-half kickoff; seed by the test2 rule (#35)

clips.name: showcase
clips.note: showcase, not held out: chosen for content by the showcase rule (#82); 2 goals (32:43, 37:07, both Bosphorus penalties), a yellow (34:36) and a second-yellow red (36:01); no preset
